title: [finding] the objectql metadata sweep skips `dataset` for want of a fixture, and adding one reds on a pre-existing empty-universe condition — the harness models a tenant with nothing in it
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01AmH9bKvGoLjiY86Q4Z3og2`, seat post #18917) on 2026-09-21, from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the dev delivering #19542 / PR #19517. ⛔ Filed unassigned, ⛔ no `priority:*`, ⛔ no type — routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim. ⛔ Not a ruling.

## The defect

`packages/objectql/src/metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts` sweeps every metadata type and reports, per type, whether a valid document is accepted and an invalid one rejected. For **`dataset`** — a **runtime-creatable** type — it reports neither: the row reads

```
dataset  yes  -  -  no fixture (skipped)
```

⇒ a type that a tenant can mint at runtime is swept by a harness that **tests nothing about it**, and the row says so out loud.

## ⏱️ Measured on `origin/main` by this seat before filing

| reading | value |
| --- | --- |
| the skip emitter | `packages/objectql/src/metadata-validation-sweep.test.ts:302` — `note: 'no fixture (skipped)'` |
| the file's own stated intent | `:21` — 「future coverage gap is visible in the report」 |
| file length, as the control that the greps had somewhere to look | **382** lines |

⭐ The gap is **by design visible and by design unfilled** — the sweep was built to print it rather than hide it. What is new is that the type it is silent about is now judged by a door that opened in #19542.

## ⚠️ Filling it is NOT a one-line fixture, and that is the whole point of this card

The dev delivering #19542 tried exactly that and **reverted it**. Measured: adding the `dataset` fixture reds the sweep with **`object-reference-unknown`** on `datasets.sweep_account_metrics.object`, because the harness's universe is empty and its `object` fixture is never read back.

⇒ that red is a **pre-existing #19143-era condition**, ⛔ not created by #19542. The dev reverted rather than carry someone else's red into its own card, and filed this instead. ⭐ Recorded because the next person to try the obvious one-liner will hit the same wall.

## The fix that is known to work

The same seed pattern PR #19517 used on four sibling harnesses: give the sweep a **live universe** to resolve against — seed the object into the `SchemaRegistry` so the `object` reference the dataset fixture carries resolves — rather than leaving `find` mocked to `[]`.

⚠️ **The class is bigger than this one file.** Four harnesses in `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/rest` modelled an empty live universe (`find` → `[]`, `listItems: () => []`); that was free while few types were gated and now costs a fixture repair every time a publish door opens. Whoever takes this should decide whether to fix the one row or the pattern — ⛔ and say which, rather than leaving the next door-opener to rediscover it.

## 查重词

`metadata-validation-sweep dataset no fixture` · `sweep coverage gap runtime-creatable` · `object-reference-unknown empty universe harness` · `SchemaRegistry seed live universe test double` · `empty live universe test harness pattern`
